# 4.7 SCC, bridges, articulation points

Phase 4 (Graphs), target rating 1600–2000. Bank status: not started.

## Patterns

### Strongly connected components (`scc`)

Group vertices that can reach each other, and build the acyclic graph of components.

**Works because:** Mutual reachability is an equivalence relation, and the graph of its classes has no directed cycle.

### Reasoning on the component graph (`condensation-reasoning`)

Answer questions on the component graph: fewest edges to make everything reachable, vertices reachable from all others.

**Works because:** The component graph is acyclic, so it has sources and sinks with simple counting rules.

### Bridges (`bridges`)

Find edges whose removal disconnects the graph, from low-link values in a depth-first traversal.

**Works because:** A tree edge (p, v) is a bridge exactly when no back edge from v's subtree reaches p or above.

### Cut vertices (`cut-vertices`)

Find vertices whose removal disconnects the graph, from low-link values.

**Works because:** A non-root vertex p is a cut vertex exactly when some child's subtree has no back edge reaching above p.
